The default driver is SQLite, per the viper configuration in cmd/memos/main.go. Tracing the save path from there to identify the actual INSERT execution.

The call chain is CreateMemo → Store.CreateMemo → driver.CreateMemo. For the default SQLite driver, this resolves to sqlite.DB.CreateMemo. The next step is to inspect that implementation and the API handler to confirm which code actually executes the INSERT.
I am checking profile.Validate and sqlite.NewDB to verify the default DSN and connection setup.

I have identified the concrete method and path for the SQL INSERT executed when a memo is saved, along with how I determined which candidate actually runs.

The concrete method is `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`. It executes the INSERT via `d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, stmt, args...)`.

I traced the execution path to confirm this candidate runs. Default configuration selects the SQLite driver. `db.NewDBDriver` routes to `sqlite.NewDB` when the driver is "sqlite". `Store.CreateMemo` delegates to the driver's `CreateMemo` method. Only the SQLite implementation handles the insert under default settings.

The call chain is APIV1Service.CreateMemo → Store.CreateMemo → sqlite.DB.CreateMemo. CreateMemoComment also invokes CreateMemo internally, but the primary save path is through CreateMemo.
